cost.evidence: together 198,271 ECU over lookback (~15,252/mo); each carries master/Kibana overhead
cost.action: Merge dev/test and low-traffic tenants into shared deployments (or serverless projects) to remove per-deployment fixed overhead.

cost.title: ML node spend without detected ML usage: dep-np
cost.action: Validate running ML jobs; downsize or remove ML nodes, or move inference to EIS (pay-per-token).

cost.title: Upgrade to unlock LogsDB / TSDS storage savings
cost.action: LogsDB index mode (8.17+/9.x) and TSDS reduce logs/metrics storage ~50–65%; pair with synthetic _source.

cost.title: Cut chat input cost: shorter prompts, then Haiku
cost.evidence: Chat input is 209 ECU over the lookback. dep-08 holds 101 ECU of inference. gp-llm-v2 26.8 million tokens at 4.50 ECU/million (121 ECU), Claude Sonnet 4.6 17.2 million tokens at 4.50 ECU/million (77 ECU). What remains is priced at 1.50 ECU per million, the Haiku rate already on this bill.
cost.action: Halve the text sent on each call: the system prompt, conversation history, and retrieved passages. Send the remaining calls that do not need the larger model to Claude Haiku.
cost.impact: ~174 ECU over the lookback (~15 ECU/mo). Half the input tokens are dropped, then any tokens that were on a larger model are priced at the Haiku rate.

notes: Sized 31 ECH deployments with a bill from 2026-08-18 through 2026-11-15 (90 days). 0 deployments had no bill in that window. Their last stored snapshot, 0 GB, is not carried into the sizing.

Ingest GB/day is the write-index sum of index.primaries.bulk.est_bytes_per_day from the Elasticsearch diagnostic bundle. Retention is the size-weighted ILM delete age on local primary store, or an explicit 30-day assumption for store without a delete policy or data-stream retention, rounded up to a whole month for the estimator. Those two are summed by solution and by region. Search disk and the Search ingest-share denominator use diagnostic local store only; K360 stored sizes are excluded from the diagnostic estimate. Search query rates use exact-window Cloud Tracker index telemetry. ECH ECU stays the K360 bill.
Nodes up for under 2 days: dep-05 (0.2d), dep-23 (0.1d). The bulk rate is still the index write phase.
ECU/mo on the sizing row is 2026-10 billing for those deployments, the last complete month.
3 billed deployments are decommissioned: not in the admin console, so no diagnostic can be captured (dep-11, dep-11, dep-07). They add no ingest and no stored GB.
1 active deployment has no diagnostic bundle (dep-08). It adds no ingest and no stored GB to the estimate. Pass --unmeasured fail to stop the run.
No delete policy or data-stream retention was available for some local store; its retention uses the 30-day assumed default.

Primary shards of write indices restarted or moved after those indices were created, so their bulk counter is younger than the write phase. Spread over the counter's own age, the bulk rate would be up to 32,218.7 GB/day higher (102% of the quoted 31,525.5). The quote keeps esdiag's figure.
Searchable snapshots, 43,245 GB, are left out of store and retention. The quote uses local primary store.

154 indices took bulk writes and have no ingest rate: 462 GB of store, 0.9% of local store (dep-09 (216 GB), dep-21 (118 GB), dep-15 (96 GB), dep-02 (25 GB), dep-23 (4 GB), dep-24 (1 GB)). They are not a data stream, a write alias, or an ILM rollover, or their write index has no write phase. Their ingest is not in bulk GB/day, so the estimate can sit below the real rate.
observability retention measures 0.6 months. The estimate is a one-year estimate, so 12 is written to the estimator.
Observability bulk is split by product classification (measured): 72.9% logs (1.0% of them Kubernetes), 24.0% metrics, 3.1% traces.
